0.comment: Illuga: Nikita, Starshyna of the Lightkeepers
0.content: Nikita, the Lightkeepers' Starshyna, is Illuga's adoptive father. He became Starshyna when Sigurd fell, rescued the orphaned boy soon after and trained him himself before housing the orphans with caregivers. He did not want to raise Illuga to die as a soldier, so he kept him in logistics for a year before letting him take the field. Illuga calls him "my old pops" and once "Dad", and borrows his sayings.

1.content: Illuga regularly brings supplies and work papers to Flins's isolated lighthouse, worried that Flins might die alone and unnoticed; Nikita calls him the Lightkeeper closest to Flins. Flins calls him "Young Master" for his polite, roundabout curiosity, offers him endless glasses of water and ends every story on a cliffhanger. Flins helped Nikita decide to let him enlist and later helped steer him toward command.

2.content: Illuga's companion, a nightingale of translucent golden light. It led him out of a mist-made forest during a Wild Hunt illusion and has stayed with him since; he always leaves a place for it by his door. It warns of danger, lights the way, reveals kuuvahki-hidden paths and dispels Wild Hunt fog. In battle it dashes through enemies.

3.content: The Lightkeeper investigation squad Illuga leads, formerly under Captain Olsson. It keeps watch over Kipumaki Cliff from Cliffwatch Camp. Members include Anleifr, a gruff ex-treasure hunter who lost his wife in the disaster three years ago; Rollon, whose brother Ivar was carried out by Illuga and can no longer fight; and Bjorn, the squad's studious tactician, who died in 6.3.

4.content: Three years before 6.3, an investigation at an ancient ruin on Kipumaki Cliff triggered a Wild Hunt surge. In the night, whispers in a strange mist turned the squad's members against each other. Captain Olsson ordered Illuga to carry the unconscious Ivar to safety and died covering them; only the two survived. The surge spilled beneath the cliffs and killed many civilians before several squads purged it. Nikita sealed the cliff off.
